name: 19146 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19146 (Philadelphia) has 201 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19146 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19146 (Philadelphia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 26 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
